name: paca-analytics-monorepo
description: Monorepo PACA Analytics - Frontend (Next.js) + Backend (Express) + Ollama AI

scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && rm -rf apps/*/node_modules apps/*/.next
scripts.prisma:push: cd apps/backend && pnpm prisma db push
scripts.prisma:generate:docker: docker compose exec backend pnpm prisma generate
scripts.prisma:push:docker: docker compose exec backend pnpm prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.prisma:reset:docker: docker compose exec backend sh -c 'pnpm prisma generate && pnpm prisma db push --accept-data-loss'
scripts.ollama:pull: docker compose exec ollama ollama pull mistral
scripts.ollama:list: docker compose exec ollama ollama list
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd apps/frontend && pnpm install && cd ../backend && pnpm install
